During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''mission''' was carried out to the [[Selnesh Imperial Detention Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Selnesh/Legends|Selnesh]], where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader [[Gebnerret Vibrion]] was being held. The mission was undertaken by a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] team consisting of the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Koris Haslam]], [[Melenna Seltrayne]], [[Barsoulentinial Enkhet]], [[Gowan Ch'lessan]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Aurin Leith]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Liak]].
